chapter: Leading his own band in Los Angeles
title: Following Armstrong around Los Angeles
summary: He recalls learning from Freddie Jenkins, hanging around Armstrong's hotel, listening to him practice and whistle, and Armstrong remembering those days.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yes I could do it. Sure I loved to do it. And I used to learn some little things from Freddie Jenkins. You know Freddie, used to play with Duke?
Yes.
Freddie Jenkins.
Now a Texas Ranger.
Is he?
At Forth Worth, yes. Yes he wears a big hat and all the......
Posey

?
Yes.

Yes. So I used to hang around hotels just to watch Louis. When he came out and went to work. If he dropped his music, I used to pick it up for him. And he was nice. Very nice. Very, very nice. And everybody tried to do everything like Louis. I remember Louis Everybody used to wear big knots in his ties. And guys would come out with knots that big, just because Louis did.
It was the same years later, start to imitate Dizzy.

Yes, yes, yes. I used to stand outside the hotel and listen to Louis practice, before he'd go to work. He'd always practice before he went out. I'd listen to him. He liked to whistle. I used to listen to him whistle. You know when he didn't have his horn he'd whistle in the street.
Did you get to know him fairly well?
Yes, I knew him fairly well.
And I mean, was he always helpful to you?
Always. But I mean sometimes he didn't have anything to tell me, but you know, just talking with him. You remember we saw him at Madison Square Garden?
Yes.
Do you remember that?
Yes, yes.
He never forgot. He always talked about the old days in California. When I first met him.
Well of course, that was quite an important period in his.....
To him, it was, too.
